A '''slave tracking device''' was an [[implant chip]] and [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] in an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] person's body to prevent them from escaping. Traveling beyond the range of the tracking transmitter, held by the enslaver, would trigger a small explosion that [[Death/Legends|killed]] the enslaved person. The device could be shut down with a [[deactivator wand]]. The [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] were implanted with transmitter chips, and Anakin tried to develop a method of locating his chip prior to being freed. Around [[44 ABY]], [[Kitaya Shuul]] had one implanted just below her shoulder blade.
